policy: Separate continuities; chronological era labels are approximate, not exact dates.

entries.title: Early Jedi traditions
entries.body: The Jedi developed traditions of Force study and service.

entries.title: Jedi at the height of the Republic
entries.body: The High Republic depicts Jedi exploration, public service and conflict with the Nihil.
entries.source: The High Republic: Light of the Jedi

entries.title: Return of the Sith
entries.body: The discovery of Darth Maul exposes the survival of the Sith.

entries.title: Militarization of the Jedi
entries.body: The Jedi become generals during a conflict that undermines the Republic.
entries.source: Attack of the Clones; The Clone Wars

entries.title: Fall of the Jedi
entries.body: Order 66 and the rise of the Empire devastate the Jedi Order.

entries.title: Redemption of Vader
entries.body: Luke rejects the Emperor and Vader saves his son.

entries.title: Luke's new school
entries.body: Luke attempts to rebuild Jedi teaching before his school collapses.

entries.title: Exegol
entries.body: Rey confronts the surviving Sith threat on Exegol.

entries.title: Je'daii of Tython
entries.body: Early Force traditions explore balance on Tython.

entries.title: Great Hyperspace War
entries.body: Conflict between the Sith Empire and Republic expands the ancient history.

entries.title: Exar Kun
entries.body: A fallen Jedi becomes a central figure in the Great Sith War.

entries.title: Revan and Malak
entries.body: The Mandalorian Wars and Jedi Civil War frame Revan's contested identity.

entries.title: Kreia and the Exile
entries.body: The Exile encounters competing teachings about agency and the Force.
entries.source: Knights of the Old Republic II

entries.title: Resurgent Sith Empire
entries.body: The Republic faces a renewed Sith Empire.

entries.title: Darth Bane
entries.body: Bane restructures the Sith around the Rule of Two.

entries.title: New Jedi Order
entries.body: Luke rebuilds Jedi institutions amid new conflicts.
entries.source: Jedi Academy trilogy; New Jedi Order

entries.title: Ahch-To
entries.body: Ancient Jedi sanctuary and site of Luke's exile.

entries.title: Mortis
entries.body: An encounter with mysterious embodiments of the Force challenges Anakin, Obi-Wan and Ahsoka.

entries.title: Dathomir
entries.body: Nightsister traditions illustrate Force practices outside Jedi and Sith institutions.

entries.title: Inquisitorius
entries.body: The Empire employs dark-side agents to hunt surviving Jedi.

entries.title: World Between Worlds
entries.body: Ezra encounters a mysterious realm connecting moments in time.

entries.title: Kyber crystals
entries.body: Kyber crystals connect lightsaber construction with Force traditions and Imperial exploitation.

entries.title: Rakatan Infinite Empire
entries.body: The Rakata represent an ancient civilization associated with Force-powered technology.

entries.title: Naga Sadow
entries.body: Sadow is a major Sith figure in the Great Hyperspace War.

entries.title: Freedon Nadd
entries.body: Nadd's legacy shapes dark-side traditions on Onderon.

entries.title: Darth Nihilus
entries.body: Nihilus embodies destructive hunger and dependence on the Force.
entries.source: Knights of the Old Republic II

entries.title: Darth Sion
entries.body: Sion's survival through pain illustrates the destructive costs of obsession.
entries.source: Knights of the Old Republic II

entries.title: Ruusan
entries.body: The Brotherhood of Darkness and Army of Light clash before Bane's new Sith tradition.
